description.value: Mink is an artisan chocolate café in downtown Vancouver specializing in handcrafted ganache chocolate bars and bonbons made with Cacao Barry chocolate. The signature experience is a personal fondue where guests roast marshmallows at their table and dip them in their choice of milk, dark, or dairy-free dark chocolate ganache. A touring cyclist would find it a memorable indulgence stop right in the city centre, across from a park at the Hornby cross street.
